fields.name: Order Urgency
fields.description: Worst deadline signal across all lines of the order, mirroring the line-level Urgency Signal. ‼️ OVERDUE beats 🔴 CRIT beats 🟠 WATCH beats 🟢 OK. Blank when all lines are delivered or have no deadline.

fields.name: Order Status
fields.description: Order-level status as a groupable dropdown. Auto-filled by an automation that copies Order Status (auto). Manual override is possible if the computed value is ever wrong. Group the table by this field.

fields.name: Customer Payment Status
fields.description: Customer-side payment state for the whole order. Tracks whether we have invoiced the client and received payment. Relevant for cash visibility and for triggering Sales provision (paid-received trigger).

fields.name: Item Name
fields.description: Auto-generated line name. Combines parent Order ID, Product, and City / Destination Tag. Marked as primary field for the table.

options.formula: IF({fldDcNa0UKQRDcuiy} = 'Delivered - Customer', '—', IF(NOT({fldAi6r7NQ4oXHXQp}), '', IF({fldFSGiSecyEPfxiH} < 0, '‼️ OVERDUE', IF({fldFSGiSecyEPfxiH} <= 3, '🔴 CRIT', IF({fldFSGiSecyEPfxiH} <= 7, '🟠 WATCH', '🟢 OK')))))

fields.name: Urgency Signal
fields.description:
Visual deadline signal. ‼️ overdue, 🔴 3 days or less, 🟠 7 days or less, 🟢 more than 7 days. 

Hides itself once the item reaches Delivered - Customer.

fields.name: Remaining Days
fields.description: Days remaining until Delivery Deadline. Negative values mean the deadline has passed.

fields.name: Item Status
fields.description: Production stage of this specific line. Drives the aggregated Order Status on the parent Order via the Line Status Rollup.

fields.name: Item Owner
fields.description: Person responsible for executing this particular item (typically the person responsible for the whole order).

fields.name: Sales Invoice
fields.description: Invoice issued to the customer by the Finance Department. Basis for calculating item sales price and ensuring no sold items are missing/forgotten.

fields.name: Procurement Invoice
fields.description: Invoice issued to the procurement department by the supplier. Basis for cost calculation and essential for timely delivery.

fields.name: Supplier Pay Status
fields.description: Payment state with the supplier for this line.

fields.name: Quality Status
fields.description: Quality check outcome. Pending until sample or batch QC is performed.

fields.name: Quality Photo
fields.description: Quality Confirmation photo as provided by supplier, latest applicable (approved) version only should be stored.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units for the item.

fields.name: Sales Price (unit)
fields.description: Sales price charged to the customer per unit, VAT excluded.

fields.name: Unit Cost
fields.description: Procurement (supplier) price per unit, which is the cost to our company.

fields.name: Logistics Cost
fields.description:
Logistics cost for delivery to the warehouse, allocated to this item (total for the row, not per-unit).

Example: if delivering 50 hoodies from the factory to the warehouse costs €1 per unit, enter €50.

If the Logistics Cost is included and cannot be calculated correctly, set as $0.

fields.name: Revenue
fields.description:
Revenue per item.
Quantity × Sales Price (unit). 

Calculated automatically.

fields.name: Total Cost
fields.description:
Total cost of delivering this item to the warehouse.
Quantity × Unit Cost + Logistics Cost.

Calculated automatically.

fields.name: Profit
fields.description:
Gross profit on the item.
Revenue − Total Cost.

Calculated automatically.

fields.name: Profit Margin %
fields.description:
Gross Profit on selected item displayed in relative terms.
Profit ÷ Revenue. 

Calculated automatically.

fields.name: Product
fields.description: Link to the Products catalogue. Selecting a product pulls its pricing tiers, MOQ, and lead times from the Products table via lookups.

fields.name: Supplier Chosen
fields.description: Link to the Suppliers table. Identifies the supplier producing this specific line.

fields.name: Orders
fields.description: Link to the parent Order (header). Every line must be attached to exactly one Order.

fields.name: Order Information
fields.description: Line-level specification: product details, sizes, colours, customisation, any constraints relevant to procurement.

fields.name: Order Files
fields.description: Files attached to this item: mockups, logos and other data that is later provided to the supplier that is necessary for production.

fields.name: Order Date
fields.description: Date the line entered procurement (typically the same as the parent Order Date).

fields.name: Shipping Deadline
fields.description: Hard deadline by which the supplier must ship to keep the order on track.

fields.name: Delivery Deadline
fields.description: Final date by which the item must be delivered to the customer. Drives Remaining Days and Urgency Signal.

fields.name: ETSO
fields.description:
Estimated Time of Shipping Out. 

Planned date the supplier ships the goods from their facility.

fields.name: ATSO
fields.description:
Actual Time of Shipping Out. 

Confirmed date when the supplier actually dispatched the goods.

Filled Automatically.

fields.name: ETA
fields.description:
Estimated Time of Arrival. 

Planned date the shipment reaches its destination (warehouse, office, or customer).

fields.name: ATA
fields.description:
Actual Time of Arrival. 

Confirmed date the shipment was actually received at destination.

Filled Automatically.

fields.name: Boxes
fields.description: Number of boxes in the shipment for this line. Used for logistics planning.

fields.name: Logistics Destination
fields.description: Type of Destination for order dispatching from the supplier (factory)

fields.name: Carrier (Supplier leg)
fields.description: Carrier on the supplier-to-warehouse leg (or supplier-to-office, depending on destination).

fields.name: City / Destination Tag
fields.description:
Optional destination tag used to differentiate lines within the same order that ship to different addresses (e.g. "Vienna", "Berlin"). Appears in the line name.

Fill out only when multiple destinations are present.

fields.name: Track&Trace Supplier
fields.description: Tracking number for the supplier-side leg.

fields.name: Track&Trace Supplier URL
fields.description: Tracking page URL for the supplier-side shipment.

fields.name: [WIP] Send to Supplier
fields.description:
WORK IN PROGRESS - INACTIVE

When checked - sends an email to the supplier with order details.

fields.name: Order ID (from Orders)
fields.description: Lookup of the parent Order's Order ID. Feeds into Item Name.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Purpose: Internal product name used across all catalogues and as the primary identifier for each product entry.
How to fill: Enter the full, descriptive product name in English. Use title case (e.g. "Classic Hoodie", "Bucket Hat"). Avoid abbreviations. This name is used internally only and may differ from the public-facing web name.

fields.name: [WEB] Name ENG
fields.description:
Purpose: Public-facing product name in English, used on the website and customer-facing materials.
How to fill: Enter the product name exactly as it should appear on the website. Use title case. If the product has no separate English web name, enter a dash (-). Must be reviewed by the marketing team before publishing ([WEB] Ready must be checked).

fields.name: [WEB] Name DE
fields.description:
Purpose: Public-facing product name in German, used on the German-language version of the website.
How to fill: Enter the German translation of the product name as it should appear on the website. Use title case and correct German grammar (including capitalisation of nouns). If no German web name applies, enter a dash (-). Must be reviewed before publishing ([WEB] Ready must be checked).

fields.name: Group Category
fields.description: Navigation door. Essentials = self-serve, filtered by product type. Industry = curated by client sector, filtered by Branche. One value per product; a product lives in exactly one door. Product families (Standard/Premium variants) inherit the same Group.

fields.name: Filter: Item Category
fields.description: Product type. Drives the Essentials-door filter and the cross-sell engine (Essentials of an adjacent type are surfaced under an Industry product). Assign exactly one type per product. Use 'Unsorted' only as a temporary intake bucket for new/unclear items pending classification; it is not a real category and should be emptied regularly. Do not create new types without approval.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description:
Under DevelopmePurpose: Stock Keeping Unit — a unique alphanumeric code used to identify a product variant in inventory and order management systems.
How to fill: Enter the SKU assigned by the supplier or your internal system. If no SKU has been assigned yet, enter "N/A". SKUs must be unique per product. Do not leave blank — use "N/A" as a placeholder until confirmed.nt

fields.name: Master Ready
fields.description:
Purpose: Indicates that the product record is complete and approved for inclusion in the Master Catalogue.
How to fill: Check this box only when all required fields for this product have been filled, reviewed, and approved by the responsible team. Do not check until pricing, MOQ, category, and all other mandatory fields are confirmed. Unchecked = product is still in progress.

fields.name: Out of Stock
fields.description:
Purpose: Flags that the product is currently unavailable for sale or procurement due to stock unavailability.

How to fill: Check this box when the product cannot be ordered or sold because stock has run out. Uncheck when stock is replenished. 

This flag can be used to filter products for inventory updates and alert the sales team to avoid offering unavailable items.

fields.name: Archived Items
fields.description: Items from old import, single-purchase items or irrelevant items that require additional consideration before being added to the catalogue properly.

fields.name: MOQ | PROC
fields.description:
Purpose: Minimum Order Quantity required by the procurement/supplier side (PROC = Procurement). The smallest quantity that can be ordered from the supplier in a single purchase.
How to fill: Enter the minimum number of units the supplier requires per order. Use a whole number (e.g. 50). If the supplier has no MOQ, enter 1. Leave blank only if the information is not yet available.

fields.name: MOQ | SALES
fields.description:
Purpose: Minimum Order Quantity for the sales side (SALES). The minimum quantity a customer must order when purchasing this product.
How to fill: Enter the minimum number of units required per customer order. Use a whole number (e.g. 50). This may differ from MOQ | PROC. If no sales minimum applies, enter 1. Leave blank only if not yet determined.

fields.name: Unit of Measure
fields.description:
Purpose: Specifies the unit used to count or measure the product for ordering and pricing purposes.
How to fill: Enter the unit of measure for this product (e.g. "pieces", "pairs", "sets", "kg"). In most cases this will be "pieces". Must be consistent with how pricing and MOQ quantities are expressed. Do not leave blank.

fields.name: Production Reference
fields.description:
Any comments expanding on the production or refePurpose: Identifies the specific product model, catalogue entry, or reference code used by the supplier for production purposes.
How to fill: Enter the supplier's reference code, catalogue number, or product specification identifier (e.g. "Supplier Name | Catalogue: REF12345"). Use the format: [Supplier Name] | [Catalogue/Reference]: [Code]. Leave blank if no reference is available from the supplier.rencing exact items.

fields.name: Sample Price | 1pc | PROC
fields.description:
Purpose: Procurement (supplier) price for a sample order or small order of 1–24 units. Used to calculate costs when ordering samples or very small quantities.
How to fill: Enter the unit price in USD as quoted by the supplier for orders of 1–24 pieces. Use the format $XX.XX (e.g. $19.00). This is the highest per-unit cost tier. Leave blank if no sample pricing has been confirmed.

fields.name: Sample Price | 10-24 pcs | PROC
fields.description:
Purpose: Procurement (supplier) price for a sample order or small order of 1–24 units. Used to calculate costs when ordering samples or very small quantities.
How to fill: Enter the unit price in USD as quoted by the supplier for orders of 1–24 pieces. Use the format $XX.XX (e.g. $19.00). This is the highest per-unit cost tier. Leave blank if no sample pricing has been confirmed.

fields.name: 25-49 pcs | PROC
fields.description:
Purpose: Procurement (supplier) unit price for orders of 25–49 pieces. Part of the tiered pricing structure used to determine costs based on order volume.
How to fill: Enter the unit price in USD as quoted by the supplier for this quantity range. Use the format $XX.XX (e.g. $12.00). Leave blank if the supplier has not confirmed pricing for this tier.

fields.name: 50-99 pcs | PROC
fields.description:
Purpose: Procurement (supplier) unit price for orders of 50–99 pieces. Part of the tiered pricing structure used to determine costs based on order volume.
How to fill: Enter the unit price in USD as quoted by the supplier for this quantity range. Use the format $XX.XX (e.g. $10.00). Leave blank if the supplier has not confirmed pricing for this tier.

fields.name: 1pc | SALES
fields.description: Displays the sales price for 1 piece, rounded to two decimal places and prefixed with €.

fields.name: Price Notes
fields.description: Special Remarks about pricing when applicable

fields.name: Prices AC
fields.description: Internal Procurement Tracker

fields.name: Time Notes
fields.description: Special Remarks about timing when applicable

fields.name: Product Input Template
fields.description: Under Development

fields.name: Palette Used
fields.description: Palette must be inserted when custom production is used.

fields.name: [WEB] Ready
fields.description:
Purpose: Indicates that the product is approved and ready to be published on the website (Web Catalogue).
How to fill: Check this box only after the [WEB] Name ENG, [WEB] Name DE, and all web-related content have been reviewed and approved. This flag controls whether the product is visible in the Web Catalogue view. Unchecked = product should not be published online.

fields.description: Under Development

fields.description:
Sourcing - A full research for a product including finding a proper supplier and all specifications (characteristics)
